Dear Miss Yonge,
We will give you the [£200](/topic/160) for the copyright of the [Cameos](/book/73). It is a rather full sum but the book is of a kind we like to possess. Some day we will get a series of actual Cameos engraved for it. But in the mean time we contract [illegible] with [one for the title page](/topic/167) & one for the cover. [I](/person/939)think you will certainly like the look of the book.
We send the '[Pupils](/book/72)' & '[Golden deeds](/book/51)' to [Mrs Montgomery Moore](/person/1042) by today’s post.
With kind regards
Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan
